message: 70F. Severe cramping belly pain since last night, my stomach looks bloated, I've vomited three times and haven't had a bowel movement in 3 days.
title: 70F. Severe cramping belly pain since last night, my stomach looks bloated, I've vomited three time…

fable.rationale: Elderly patient with severe abdominal pain, distension, repeated vomiting, and no bowel movement for 3 days suggests possible bowel obstruction; requires same-day/emergency evaluation.

medgemma.rationale: Severe abdominal pain, vomiting, and lack of bowel movement suggest a potential obstruction or other serious condition requiring urgent evaluation.

v25.rationale: A 70-year-old with severe cramping abdominal pain since last night, visible distension, three episodes of vomiting and no bowel movement for 3 days reports the cardinal pattern of bowel obstruction, which requires immediate emergency imaging, decompression and surgical assessment.

earlyActions.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.
